variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: the ferry at the mill, a grumble about Red Corwin, a jeer at the player.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: The ferry below Wenna's mill will take you to the far bank.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: That greedy Red Corwin has left the north road empty of honest folk. Chase his wretched bandits off Crow Hill before they come south.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: You look awful scrawny for a wolf-hunter. Hah, hah, hah...!

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Three townsfolk: a cackling old miner, a townsman packing up for the surface, a townswoman's greeting.

rumour1.speaker: Old Miner
rumour1.text: Dig, stranger, dig! Hee, hee, hee...!

rumour2.speaker: Townsman
rumour2.text: That does it! First the Ogres take the deep shafts then they come for the town. I'm heading for the surface!

variants.specifics: Vell: Fisk, Brena and Tansy, folk of Vell.

rumour1.speaker: Fisk
rumour1.text: Hurry! Mayor Pellig is expecting you in his house across the village. There's a little boat behind the inn that can carry you over to him.

rumour2.speaker: Brena
rumour2.text: Welcome to Vell. Bodo's inn is just there on your left.

rumour3.speaker: Tansy
rumour3.text: Good work saving Mortimer, stranger! I hear Hesper is telling everyone about it!

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Three townsfolk: Dask, a soldier of the garrison; Yorra, a townswoman; Mott, an idler by the well.

rumour1.speaker: Dask
rumour1.text: March on, Wanderer. Your strength and the garrison's spears will drive back these foul Ogres.

rumour2.speaker: Yorra
rumour2.text: How can the garrison hold off the Ogres? This is terrible! Where will we go?

rumour3.speaker: Mott
rumour3.text: Shouldn't you be off to Grael Gorge by now?

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Three townsfolk of Tolvin: a brush-off, a woman with leeches on her, a girl who saw an Urchin by the Mayor's boathouse.

rumour1.speaker: Fisherman
rumour1.text: You're thinking of my brother, sorry.

rumour2.speaker: Fishwife
rumour2.text: Yeeeugh! Get these leeches off my legs!

rumour3.speaker: Maiden
rumour3.text: Ew! I saw one of those Urchins sneak right into the Mayor Gorvane's boathouse!

variants.specifics: Olvane: Fennick, drunk in the square; Hulda, a townswoman; Ursin, the College registrar.

rumour1.speaker: Fennick
rumour1.text: What're ya gonna do? Hex me?

rumour2.speaker: Hulda
rumour2.text: Grelvin's Undead are at the College gate! They need every hand up there!

rumour3.speaker: Ursin
rumour3.text: Olvane must not fall to Grelvin. Hold fast for the honor of the College!

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Three townsfolk: Tibbet, Gorm and Fenna.

rumour1.speaker: Tibbet
rumour1.text: We must drive out Kragan! Smash his Trolls and take back the Upper Gate.

rumour3.speaker: Fenna
rumour3.text: There is a good inn next to Haskel's goat pens.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Three townsfolk of Orvak: Corla with a tip, Ebbe robbed by the Imps, Nissa with gossip about Warden Holgarth's jail.

rumour1.speaker: Corla
rumour1.text: I thought heroes didn't mind a little heat. Try keeping out of the lava.

rumour2.speaker: Ebbe
rumour2.text: My tools... taken... every last one.

rumour3.speaker: Nissa
rumour3.text: I hear Warden Holgarth's jail got overrun with rats last week. Odd things happening around here lately.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Three townsfolk of Torvel Cross: a market woman who stays home, a townsman who wants revenge, a flirting barmaid.

rumour1.speaker: Townswoman
rumour1.text: No, I won't go out to market while those Ogres hold the north road!

rumour2.speaker: Townsman
rumour2.text: We must take up arms and avenge the carters the Ogres killed on the road!

rumour3.speaker: Barmaid
rumour3.text: Hello, stranger! Come see me again once you're famous.

variants.specifics: Corvale: Hettie, Darvel and Pella of Corvale: an Ogre at the gate, Gorbrak's raids, a flirt.

rumour1.speaker: Hettie
rumour1.text: An Ogre just went by my gate! Watch out! He can't be far off!

rumour2.speaker: Darvel
rumour2.text: Gorbrak must have found a pass through the hills. One week the north road was safe, the week after it was crawling with Ogres and wolves! They want our grain.

rumour3.speaker: Pella
rumour3.text: You're not from these parts, are you? Too bad you're not one of Captain Brannoc's soldiers. I just adore soldiers!
